highlights: Talk with an agent by voice: tap the microphone in a chat or a channel, and the agent listens, answers aloud and listens again.
Workflows on the phone: see runs, approve or retry steps, pin a workflow to the sidebar, and edit or make workflows.
Agent chats have threads, as on desktop. Start, rename, archive and send files in a thread from the agent's name.
Share to an agent from any iPhone app without opening OpenBot.
Manage a server's Vault and connect Bitwarden or Vaultwarden, plus a Dutch interface and new Marketplace apps.
